run a command

Usage:
  ops exec <WORD...>

Every word after "exec" is passed through as written, so flags go before "exec".

Arguments:
  <WORD...>    the command and its arguments

Global Flags:
  -h, --help            print help
  -v, --verbose         say more (repeatable)
      --color string    when to color (default auto) [auto|always|never]
